Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the intro. We're excited to get the HelioCloud listing live on GCP and figure out the co-sell procurement path. I've attached our current MSA (Helio_MSA_v2.pdf) and a short spreadsheet of purchasing rules — our procurement team needs to confirm PO flow, legal signoff cadence, and whether we can route purchases via our parent procurement org.

High-level asks from our side:
- Walk us through Redwood's GCP listing onboarding checklist and timelines.
- Confirm required commercial artifacts for GCP procurement (invoice templates, tax forms, reseller attestations).
- Clarify who at Redwood will own the marketplace SKU mapping and billing handoff.

Can we kick off a 30–45 min call tomorrow 11/4 or Thurs 11/5? Our procurement lead (Kevin Lee) can join if we lock a time.

Best,
Elena Vargas
Head of Partnerships, HelioCloud
(elena@heliocloud.com)

Adding the internal checklist snippet inline to speed things up — save as a draft we can attach to the MAP during the call:

- Commercial artifacts: invoice template, W-9/UK tax forms, reseller attestation (if required by Helio).
- Billing handoff: SKU mapping authored by Product (Camila) -> Pricing (Jonas) -> Marketplace ops (Vivek) for final SKU and pricing matrix.
- Purchase path: support PO-based purchases + DocuSign SOW for services.
- Legal: expect 7–10 business days for standard MSA review; expedite if same-day signature required (we can propose pre-signed SOW).
- Integrations: GCP procurement often wants a listing ID and seller portal contact for invoicing; Redwood should provide a single contact.

I'll upload a cleaned draft of the SKU mapping and the onboarding runbook before the call.

Thanks, Tessa and team. 11/5 9:30 AM PT works best for Kevin and our procurement lead — we booked that slot. A few clarifications from procurement attached (Helio_procurement_requirements.xlsx):
- Our finance org requires a registered vendor Tax ID and a sample invoice before processing POs.
- For co-sell deals, we need to know whether Redwood will invoice Helio or whether customers will be billed through Google Cloud Marketplace (we prefer the latter for consolidated billing).
- We have specific doc signing rules: our legal approves MSA redlines only after commercial terms are agreed.

We can scope co-sell enablement in two phases: 1) Listing + billing confirmation, 2) Joint GTM enablement and lead routing. Would appreciate if Redwood confirms which items you can deliver before the listing goes live (SKU mapping, seller contact, invoice sample).

Looking forward to the call.

- Vivek: upload final SKU mapping + sample invoice (deliverable: SKU_matrix_v1.csv) — owner: Vivek (due: 11/04 EOD).
- Camila: final product requirements for listing (metadata, billing unit, usage meter) — owner: Camila (due: 11/04 noon).
- Jonas: commercial checklist & recommended pricing cadence to share with Helio procurement — owner: Jonas (due: 11/04 EOD).
- Tessa: assemble MAP + DocuSign link for the initial SOW stub (I will publish MAP link in the calendar invite).

For the co-sell question: Redwood supports both billing models. For consolidated billing via GCP Marketplace we will need the listing to be configured as a Marketplace-billed SKU — we will handle the seller onboarding and provide the invoice sample. If Helio prefers to have Redwood invoice directly, we can also support that path; either way the marketplace listing can be configured to support the chosen flow. We'll confirm which path Helio selects during the kickoff.

I'll post the mutual action plan doc and a DocuSign stub ahead of the meeting. See the MAP here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C-Redwood-Helio-MAP
DocuSign (SOW stub): https://www.docusign.net/Helio-Redwood-MAP-sign

Talk soon — Tessa
